title: Tilting Button
summary: A button that leans toward the pointer.
description: A button that leans toward the pointer.
accessibility_notes: Use a real <button>, keep a visible :focus-visible ring, and never signal state with colour alone.
ai_usage: Hero calls to action. Keep the tilt under 10° — beyond that the label distorts and the button starts to feel unstable rather than responsive.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Tilting Button</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "button-3d-tilt-hover",
    "title": "Tilting Button",
    "summary": "A button that leans toward the pointer.",
    "description": "A button that leans toward the pointer.",
    "theme": "buttons",
    "categories": ["button", "action"],
    "tags": ["button", "action", "tilt", "3d", "pointer", "hover"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "beginner",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Use a real <button>, keep a visible :focus-visible ring, and never signal state with colour alone.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--max", "description": "Maximum tilt", "default": "9deg" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Retune through the custom properties", "Scale for a compact variant"],
    "ai_usage": "Hero calls to action. Keep the tilt under 10° — beyond that the label distorts and the button starts to feel unstable rather than responsive."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    .fx { padding: 1rem 2rem; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: linear-gradient(150deg, #7c5cff, #4c1d95);
      color: #fff; font: inherit; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .15s ease-out;
      box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(76,29,149,.5); }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="fx" type="button" id="tb">Get started</button>
  <script>
    (function () {
      var b = document.getElementById("tb");
      b.addEventListener("pointermove", function (e) {
        var r = b.getBoundingClientRect();
        var x = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width - .5, y = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height - .5;
        b.style.transform = "perspective(600px) rotateY(" + x * 18 + "deg) rotateX(" + -y * 18 + "deg)";
      });
      b.addEventListener("pointerleave", function () { b.style.transform = ""; });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
